08137 Shenatstsar {shen-ats-tsar'}

源自巴比倫文; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Shenazar 1; 1

示拿薩 = "英明的領袖"
1) 猶大皇室中人, 所羅巴伯的叔父 (#代上 3:18|)
record.edic_text:
08137 Shenatstsar {shen-ats-tsar'}

apparently of Babylonian origin;; n pr m

AV - Shenazar 1; 1

Shenazar = "splendid leader"
1) a Judaite of the royal line, son or grandson of king Jehoiachin of
   Judah and uncle of Zerubbabel
